title: Host list rows exclude structurally identified Owl copies without merging real repeated cards
steps: Read an invented looping Owl carousel and control lists in the real browser at desktop1440 and mobile390.
expect: The looping Owl list reports only its two canonical original cards, not four copied cards or lists nested inside copies.
Four canonical cards with identical words remain four items.
Ordinary cloned classes, unverified Owl-like markup and clone-only stages retain their original item counts.
fence: Do not deduplicate by text, suppress unexplained rows or change the site-check row-count requirements. No customer-site writes or model calls.

tests: list rows count canonical Owl items without counting clone subtrees or deduplicating real repeated cards
